summary: # CLO Master Direct Course Lesson 30: Christmas Sweater Making Tutorial ## Introduction Hello everyone, good evening! Can everyone hear my voice? Tomorrow is our birthday, and today we are going to talk about our Christmas theme. This time we have provided you with the DXF document; it is the same as the previous way of obtaining it. ## Model Setup First, we need to open a model, or we can open a model downloaded from Connect. You can download directly from Connect. ### Symmetry Setup Next, let's make it a left-to-right symmetry. We'll put our symmetry board in place; it's the same as before. Let's position it accordingly. Because the gingerbread man is next to me, my board is not easy to place. ### Layer Arrangement Now, let's arrange our board to the model. Then, we will cut off this part. We will make a double layer. Using this shortcut, we will arrange the layer relationship first. I will delete the other side first so that I can do the topography right away. With the layer relationship set up like this, I only need to do it once. Next, let's arrange the collar and make it a little bit bigger. We will put the main body together. We are going to put the gingerbread man, snowflake, and Christmas tree together later. ## Sleeve and Backlight Adjustments We are going to make an opening on the side of the sleeve and fold it down. We will make a backlight on the other side. I made a backlight here. Open the model and make a slight adjustment to the sleeve. I forgot to sew it; I will fix that later. We will also make a backlight on the side of the Christmas tree, according to the baseline. We will make a simple seam and put it next to it. ### Sleeve Adjustments Here, the two sleeves are cut together, and we will move them together to avoid mistakes when applying other materials later. Then, we will cut the Christmas tree and place it on the front. Since it's symmetrical, we are going to take it out of its joint or cut it off on the other side. ## Snowflake and Gingerbread Man Details Now, we are going to deal with some of the other versions of this one with our snowflakes. In the middle of the snowflakes, we are going to sew them together with this dress, and we will take these little circles and hook them up. ### Snowflake Assembly Then, we'll sew them together. We'll go a little back and then come to the bottom to work on the front and then this side. This one here that’s not hooked up will take another row. Now, we will start putting this snowflake on top of our model and place it over this dress. #### Arranging Snowflakes Let's have a look at this snowflake. There are the big spots, one small, and another as a board. We are going to put it in the middle first, then make a copy, paste it, and then put it together with the big circle. It feels like this part is a little dense, so I'm going to place it on the other side. We will arrange it directly to the outside. Let me show you how it works. This is the big snowflake; now we will create the small one. ### Repetition of the Small Snowflake We will make the small one multiple times until we are satisfied. The circles here don't have to be the same as mine; feel free to set the circle and the size of the snowflake as you prefer. ## Finalizing Snowflake Design If you think there’s one more, just delete the other one. Then it is also arranged to be added to the outside. The other side is the same; there is also this circle on the other side. Do a copy and paste of the same. The rest are the same. ### Completing the Seam Now, we are going to make a seam for it. There are a few small circles here. Let's hook them up into a sheet and then sew it up. That’s it! ## Gingerbread Man Assembly Now we will sew the gingerbread man together with the dress. Let's not forget to sew the snowflakes on the sleeves. We will sew the snowflakes together with the sleeves and then sew the dress. We will also make symmetry on the other side. ### Adding Decorative Elements Now we will sew the circles on the gingerbread man. These circles are for making a style with the dress; these are just the circles of the dress. Just sew them together. We will sew this one and make a seam. ### Layering the Gingerbread Man Next, we will make the bottom layer of this gingerbread man. After we finish the bottom layer, we have to follow it because we want to create a double-layer effect. Then, in the middle, let's put these basic lines out for it and make a collar layer from the outside so that the inner line can be automatically sewn together. ## Finishing Touches We will remove this joint because some of the original three big circles we don't need. Then, we will simulate and make the details of the gingerbread man, for example, the details on his hat. I will realign it now. ### Adding Features to the Gingerbread Man Let’s hook it up as a plate. When sewing on the side here, pay attention to the details and change it to patterns. The same goes for the scarf. We will cut it into pieces and add it to the outside. ### Decorations and Final Adjustments There are some circles below this, so we will make some round decorations for it. We will draw it directly with this inner circle and then make a copy and paste for it. Now, we will draw five circles for it and adjust the position accordingly. We will make these inner circles a cut-and-sew. This way, we can create a cover design later. The scarf will have some round decorations as well. ## Conclusion In summary, we have completed the Christmas sweater design with the gingerbread man and snowflakes. I hope everyone enjoyed this tutorial. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask in the comments. Wishing everyone a Happy New Year! This live stream ends here.
